description: This is a React component for the 'LibraryPage' in a streaming frontend application. It manages content listing, filtering, watchlist actions, and video playback modal.

methods.name: fetchContent
methods.description: Fetches content list from API or uses fallback data.

methods.name: onFiltersChange
methods.description: Updates filter parameters and URL search parameters.

methods.name: onPlay
methods.description: Handles playing a selected content item and logs history.

methods.name: onAddWatchlist
methods.description: Adds an item to the user's watchlist.

methods.name: onRemoveWatchlist
methods.description: Removes an item from the user's watchlist.
